parts.name: Stocks up today
parts.text: Share of S&P 100 stocks trading higher today.

parts.name: Stocks above 200-day
parts.text: Share of S&P 100 stocks in a long-term uptrend.

parts.name: VIX
parts.text: Expected S&P 500 swings over 30 days. Above 30 = fear.

parts.name: VIX vs 3-month VIX
parts.text: Above 1 (short-term fear higher than long-term) usually only happens in sell-offs.

parts.name: Put/call volume
parts.text: More puts than calls traded = people buying protection.

parts.name: SPY options gamma
parts.text: Negative gamma: dealers' hedging tends to make moves bigger in both directions.

parts.name: Dark pool index
parts.text: Percentile of the last year. High = more buying in dark pools.

parts.name: News tone
parts.text: How positive market news is vs the last year (GDELT).
